install: if ! command -v ffmpeg >/dev/null 2>&1 || ! command -v ffprobe >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ffmpeg; fi && pip install --no-input -q --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu torch && pip install --no-input -q numpy librosa fonttools pillow playwright faster-whisper transformers && ( if ! command -v colab >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ ! -x "$HOME/.local/bin/colab" ]; then if command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then uv tool install --quiet google-colab-cli; else pip install --no-input -q google-colab-cli; fi; fi ) && ( if ! command -v doppler >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ ! -x "$HOME/.local/bin/doppler" ]; then _dp_ver=3.77.1; mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin"; _dp_tar="$(mktemp /tmp/doppler-XXXXXX.tar.gz)"; trap 'rm -f "$_dp_tar"' EXIT; curl -fsSL "https://github.com/DopplerHQ/cli/releases/download/${_dp_ver}/doppler_${_dp_ver}_linux_amd64.tar.gz" -o "$_dp_tar"; tar -xzf "$_dp_tar" -C "$HOME/.local/bin" doppler; chmod +x "$HOME/.local/bin/doppler"; fi ) && if ! command -v hyperframes >/dev/null 2>&1 || ! command -v elevenlabs >/dev/null 2>&1; then npm install -g hyperframes @elevenlabs/cli; fi && touch ~/.bashrc && sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' ~/.bashrc && _path_line='export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"' && (grep -qxF "$_path_line" ~/.bashrc || printf '%s\n' "$_path_line" >> ~/.bashrc) && _hf_line='if [ -z "${HYPERFRAMES_BROWSER_PATH:-}" ] && [ -d /opt/ms-playwright ]; then _hf_browser="$(find /opt/ms-playwright -maxdepth 4 -name chrome-headless-shell -type f 2>/dev/null | head -n 1 || true)"; if [ -n "$_hf_browser" ]; then export HYPERFRAMES_BROWSER_PATH="$_hf_browser"; fi; unset _hf_browser; fi' && (grep -qxF "$_hf_line" ~/.bashrc || printf '%s\n' "$_hf_line" >> ~/.bashrc)
